digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit DET criterion
propositions: Bug fixes with non-test file_impact must escalate from light advisory tier to full blocking DET rubric on explicit review-plan, ensuring complex fixes are substantively reviewed before landing.
Gerrit DET criterion must block bug-fix commits exceeding 150 non-test lines lacking a current or code-drifted plan-review attestation, teaching authors to declare blast radius.

Attestation verification for B2 must read cross-host via opcert_from_record and trusted_env_keyring(principal), never via own-env plan_review_status, to support review-bot hosts distinct from the environment that ran plan-review.

Verdict classification must accept certified/stale-code/stale-head attestations, flag compute_validity's remaining plan-review literals and op-cert failure verdicts, and fail-open only on unavailable/error/unknown-future.

Non-test line classification excludes tests/** and conftest.py; the 150-line threshold is a single shared constant imported by both the Gerrit criterion and backtest script, with exact set equality to 13 hand-adjudicated substantive bug-fix commits over 113-commit corpus.
